name: The Naughty Red Hood
source:
Meet Virginia, a 19 years old young woman who ventures into the woods to visit her grandma. Haunted by the memories of the wolf that once tried to bite her. She is now determined to conquer her fears and prove to herself that she is no longer afraid.

As she encounters a mysterious man in wolf's clothing, she finds herself on a journey filled with fear, excitement, and lust. She must outrun the man while navigating both the woods and her own lewdness.

Will she reach her destination still innocent, or will she surrender to her own inner lust and the primal desires of the man with a sinister smile? 

[From [url=https://mrcreep-games.itch.io/the-naughty-red-hood]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
19岁的年轻女子弗吉尼娅，走进树林，前去探望奶奶。曾经有一匹狼试图咬她，那段记忆始终纠缠着她。如今，她决心战胜恐惧，向自己证明，她已经不再害怕。

遇见一个身披狼装的神秘男人后，她踏上了一段充满恐惧、兴奋与欲望的旅途。她必须在树林中逃离男人的追逐，同时面对自己内心的情欲。

她能保持纯真，抵达目的地吗？还是会屈从于内心的欲望，以及那个带着阴险笑容的男人的原始渴望？

[摘自[url=https://mrcreep-games.itch.io/the-naughty-red-hood]itch.io[/url]]
